{{Tocright}}
'''Events''' are limited-time happenings that give special effects to all players in the server.  

* They have a chance to occur every 30 minutes on the dot (XX:00 or XX:30), and are the same ''globally'' across all servers. 
* Players can use [[Relics]] to start certain events. (Those events are local to the server.)
* Some are manually initiated by Developers during "Admin Abuse" times.  
<!-- uh, yeah, not lately they're not. ** Announcements for these are posted on the [https://discord.gg/prospecting Discord].  -->

== Regular Events ==
<tabber>
|-|Blizzard =
The '''Blizzard''' is an every-30-minute event lasting 15 minutes on [[Snowy Mountain]] only. It can also be spawned using the [[Relics#tabber-Snow_Globe|Snow Globe]] relic.

=== Effects ===
* Multiplicative 1.5&times; '''[[Stats|Luck]]''' and '''1.5&times; items''' from panning at following locations:
** '''{{Frostbite River}}'''  
** '''{{Frostbite Waterfall}}'''  
** '''{{Frozen Peak}}'''  

=== Dialogue ===
* Arrival: ''"Increased luck and amount on Snowy Island!"''  

[[File:BlizzardProspecting.png|center|500px]]

|-|Geode Shower=
The '''Geode Shower''' is an every-30-minute event lasting 15 minutes. The Geode shower drops down meteors that contains a lot of geodes.  It can also be spawned using the [[Relics#tabber-Cosmic_Resonator|Cosmic Resonator]] relic.

=== Effects ===
* Meteors containing [[Geodes]] drop over the course of 15 minutes. Each has at most 20 geodes each.
* Meteors can only fall at the following locations:
** '''{{Fortune River}}'''
** '''{{Sunset Beach}}'''
** '''{{Fortune River Delta}}'''
** '''{{Windswept Beach}}'''
** '''{{Frostbite River}}'''

=== Dialogue ===
* Arrival: ''"Look up! Meteors are coming down bringing tons of geodes with them!"''  

[[File:GeodeEvent.png|center|500px]]

|-|Meteor Shower=
The '''Meteor Shower''' is an every-30-minute event lasting '''20 minutes'''. It can also be purchased with Robux or spawned with a [[Meteor Fragment]], sending a server-wide message naming the buyer/spawner. Unlike other events, Meteor Showers can be "stacked", i.e. starting an additional one adds to the existing time. 

=== Effects ===
* Multiplicative 2&times; [[Stats|Luck]] for everyone in the server.  
* 1-4 [[Meteor Shards]] can be obtained commonly from panning.  

=== Dialogue ===
* Arrival: ''"A meteor shower has begun!"''  
* Player-started: ''"A meteor shower has been started by [Player]!"''  
* Departure: ''"The meteor shower has ended!"''  

[[File:MeteorShower.png|center|500px]]

|-|Mythic Rift =
A '''Mythic Rift''' can be spawned using the [[Relics#tabber-Mythic_Summon|Mythic Summon]] relic.

=== Effects ===
* Guarantees that one player will find a '''mythic ore''' from that area.  
* Once obtained by one player, a server-wide message announces it, and the Rift disappears.  

=== Dialogue ===
* Arrival: Dig in the zone for a chance to obtain the mythic gem!  

[[File:MythicRift.png|center|500px]]

|-|Nimue's Blessing=
'''Nimue's Blessing''' is an every-30-minute event lasting '''15 minutes''' in the Overgrown Caves ('''not''' including Abyssal Depths). It can also be spawned using the [[Relics#tabber-Spirit_Orb|Spirit Orb]] relic.  

=== Effects ===
* Multiplicative 1.5&times; '''[[Stats|Luck]]''' and increased [[Modifiers|modifier]] chance from panning at following locations:
** '''{{Overgrown Grotto}}'''  
** '''{{Deeproot Spring}}'''  
** '''{{Enchanted Ruins}}''' 


=== Dialogue ===
* Arrival: ''"Increased Luck and Modifier chance."''  

[[File:Nimue's Blessing.png|center|500px]]

|-|River Rapids=
'''River Rapids''' is an every-30-minute event lasting '''15 minutes''' in {{Fortune River}} and {{Fortune River Delta}}. It can also be spawned using the [[Relics#tabber-Rain_Stone|Rain Stone]] Relic.

=== Effects ===
* Provides '''2&times; items''' from panning at the following locations:
** '''{{Fortune River}}'''
** '''{{Fortune River Delta}}'''  

=== Dialogue ===
* Arrival: ''"2x items from Fortune River and Fortune River Delta!"''  

[[File:RiverRapids.png|center|500px]]

|-|Solar Flare=
The '''Solar Flare''' is an every-30-minute event lasting '''15 minutes'''. It can also be spawned with a [[Solar Token]] relic.  A focused 10-minute Solar Flare can also be summoned with a [[Relics#tabber-Solar_Magnifier|Solar Magnifier]] relic.

=== Effects ===
* Small glowing patches spawn randomly on deposit areas.  
* Digging in these spots increases mineral '''weight''' by 2&times; and increases [[Modifiers|modifier]] chance.  

=== Dialogue ===
* Arrival: Dig in the flare zones for improved size and modifier chance!  

[[File:SolarFlare.png|center|500px]]

|-|Volcanic Eruption =
The '''Volcanic Eruption''' is an every-30-minute event lasting '''15 minutes''' on {{Caldera Island}}.  It can also be spawned using the [[Relics#tabber-Infernal_Idol|Infernal Idol]] relic.

=== Effects ===
* Increases mineral '''size''' by 2&times; and grants '''1.5&times; items''' from panning at the following locations:  
** '''{{Volcanic Sands}}'''  
** '''{{Windswept Beach}}'''  
** '''{{Volcanic Springs}}'''
** '''{{Magma Furnace}}'''  
** '''{{Infernal Heart}}'''  

=== Dialogue ===
* Arrival: ''"Increased size and amount on Caldera Island!"''  

[[File:VolcanicEruption.png|center|500px]]

|-|Swamp Fog =
The '''Swamp Fog''' is an every-30-minute event lasting '''15 minutes''' in {{Rotwood Swamp}} and {{Fungal Marsh}}. It can also be spawned using the [[Relics#tabber-Sealed_Fog|Sealed Fog]] relic.

=== Effects ===
* Multiplicative 1.5&times; [[Stats|Luck]] and hides you from beasts while panning at the following locations:  
** '''{{Rotwood Swamp}}'''  
** '''{{Fungal Marsh}}'''  

[[File:SwampFog.png|500px|center]]

|-|Modifier Surge =
The '''Modifier Surge''' is an every-30-minute event lasting 15 minutes that applies to every location. It can also be spawned using the [[Relics#tabber-Concentrated_Chaos|Concentrated Chaos]] relic.

=== Effects ===
* Provides a '''2&times; modifier chance''' for all items obtained.
* Increases Modifier Luck by 2&times;, meaning rarer [[Modifiers|modifiers]] appear significantly more often.

=== Dialogue ===
* Arrival: ''"2x modifier chance and rare modifiers appear more often!"''

[[File:ModifierSurge.png|500px|center]]

|-|Starfall =
The '''Starfall''' event is a '''15 minute''' event in [[Meteor Valley]]. It can also be spawned using the [[Relics#tabber-Starcaller|Starcaller]] relic.

=== Effects ===
* Multiplicative 1.5&times; to both '''{{Stat|Luck}}''' and '''{{Stat|Modifier Boost}}''' from panning at the following locations.
** '''{{Meteor Falls}}'''  
** '''{{Starfall River}}'''
** '''{{Astral Caverns}}'''  

[[File:Starfallevent.png|center|500px]]

|-|Sandstorm =
The '''Sandstorm''' event lasts '''15 minutes''' and affects the {{Sunscorched Desert}}. It can also be spawned using the [[Relics#tabber-Sand_Spirit|Sand Spirit]] relic.

=== Effects ===
* Multiplicative 1.5&times; to both '''{{Stat|Luck}}''' and '''{{Stat|Modifier Boost}}''' from panning at the following locations.
** '''{{Sandstone Stream}}'''  
** '''{{Mystic Floodplains}}'''
** '''{{Lifespring Oasis}}'''

[[File:Sandstorm banner.png|center|500px]]

|-|The Void =
[[The Void]] is an event lasting 30 minutes. It can spawn naturally or it can be started by an admin during Admin Abuse, or by a player using a [[Void Shard]] relic. Players can also open the portal by purchasing it from the Robux shop.

[[File:TheVoidBanner.png|400px|center]]

</tabber>

== Limited-Time Events ==
<tabber>
|-|Hallows' Eve =
The '''Hallows' Eve''' event happens every hour at XX:00 during the '''Halloween Event''' and lasts '''15 minutes'''.

=== Effects ===
* Additive 2&times; (+1&times;) '''[[Stats|Luck]]''' across the whole map. 
* Chance of getting the Spooky modifier on your ores.

=== Dialogue ===
* Arrival: ''THE NIGHT HAS COME MY SERVANTS! SPOOKY MODIFIER CHANCE AND 2x LUCK!''  

[[File:Hallowseve.webp|center|500px]]

|-|Candy Canes =
The '''Candy Canes''' event happens every hour at XX:00 during the '''Christmas Event''' and lasts '''15 minutes'''.

=== Effects ===
* Allows the {{Enchant|Festive}} [[Mutations|Mutation]] to be obtained at base chance of 2.2%
* Base {{Enchant|Prismatic}} Mutation chances decreased from 0.63% -> 0.57%
* Base {{Enchant|Diamond}} Mutation chances decreased from 2.4% -> 2.2%
* Base {{Enchant|Gold}} Mutation chances decreased from 6.3% -> 5.7%
* Base {{Enchant|Silver}} Mutation chances decreased from 16% -> 14%

== Dialogue ==
* Arrival: ''Chance for a powerful Equipment mutation!'' 

|-|Rose Rain=
The '''Rose Rain''' event happens every hour at XX:00 during the '''Valentine's Event''' and lasts '''15 minutes'''.

=== Effects ===
* Luck Boost
* Chance of getting Rosy and Charming modifier on ores

== Dialogue ==
* Arrival: ''Petals are falling, boosting luck and modifying ores'' 

[[File:Rose_Rain.png|center|500px]]

|-|Egg Hunt =
The '''Egg Hunt''' event happens every hour at XX:00 during the '''Easter Event''' and lasts '''15 minutes'''.

=== Effects ===
* Luck Boost
* Increased spawn rate for Easter Eggs

== Dialogue ==
* Arrival: ''Boosted Luck! Easter Eggs spawn more often.'' 

[[File:EggHunt.png|center|500px]]

|-|Shifting Tides =
[[File:Shifting tides at Windswept beach.png|300px|right]]
The '''Shifting Tides''' event happens every hour at XX:05 during the '''Summer Event''' and lasts '''15 minutes'''.

=== Effects ===
* Additive +1&times; {{Stat|Luck}} Boost
** The luck boost applies to all locations, not just beaches.
* Chance of [[Modifiers#Tidal|Tidal modifier]] on ores collected at beach deposits.
** Beach deposits will have large swirling circles, but it is not necessary to dig/pan in those circles - the Tidal modifier chance applies to the whole deposit.

== Dialogue ==
* Arrival: ''+1x luck and Tidal modifier chance at beach deposits!'' 

[[File:Shifting Tides.png|center|500px]]

|-|Night of the Bonfire =
The '''Night of the Bonfire''' event has a chance of occurring every time the [[Seashell Isle#Bonfire|Bonfire]] is lit during the '''Summer Event'''. It lasts 15 minutes.

=== Effects ===
* Multiplicative 2&times; {{Stat|Luck}} Boost
* Chance of [[Modifiers#Hearthflame|Hearthflame modifier]] on ores

== Dialogue ==
* Arrival: ''2x Luck, +Hearthflame mod chance'' 

[[File:Night of the Bonfire.png|center|500px]]

</tabber>
